title: Collecting and Summarising Data: Averages, Spread and Grouped Data
seo_title: Grade 9 Collecting and Summarising Data Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade 9: 5.1 Collect, organise and summarise data
standard_text: Organise numerical data in different ways in order to summarise by determining measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and measures of dispersion (range, percentiles, quartiles, interquartile range, extremes and outliers); group data into intervals; organise and record data using stem-and-leaf displays.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 9 data handling worksheets: mean, median, mode, range, frequency tables, grouped data and stem-and-leaf diagrams. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Mean from a table: Σ(value × frequency) ÷ Σfrequency.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Mean = total ÷ number of values; median = middle value in order; mode = most common; range = highest − lowest.
  • From a frequency table: mean = Σ(value × frequency) ÷ Σfrequency.
  • Grouped data: use the modal class and estimate with midpoints.
  • An outlier can change the mean a lot but not the median.

Examples

Example

Marks 4, 6, 7, 7, 30

mean 10,8

median 7

Answer: the median describes the data better

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Median without orderingOrder first.
Dividing by the groupsDivide by the total frequency.
Ignoring outliersThey pull the mean.
